Inverted Question Mark Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Inverted Question Mark is 168. Hold Alt, type 168 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Inverted Question Mark also has the Unicode codepoint U+00BF, so you can type it with Alt+191 on Windows, search for U+00BF in macOS's Character Viewer, use ¿ in HTML, or \00BF in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥⇧/ for Inverted Question Mark; shortcuts can differ on other layouts. HTML also defines the named entity ¿ for Inverted Question Mark, but the numeric form ¿ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type inverted question mark on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 6 8 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Inverted Question Mark character (¿) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type inverted question mark on macOS

On a US keyboard layout, press ⌥⇧/ to insert Inverted Question Mark. This shortcut assumes a US layout; other layouts may remap it.

If the shortcut does not work on your layout, open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Inverted Question Mark" and click the character.

How to use inverted question mark in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00BF"; ()
  • Python: \u00BF or chr(0xBF)
  • JavaScript: \u00BF or String.fromCodePoint(0xBF)
  • JSON: "\u00BF"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Inverted Question Mark?

The legacy Alt code for Inverted Question Mark is 168. Hold Alt, type 1 6 8 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ¿ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ¿, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+191 not work?

Alt+191 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Inverted Question Mark?

The Unicode codepoint for Inverted Question Mark is U+00BF. You can use this value in HTML as ¿, in CSS as \00BF, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ¿ on a Mac?

On a US Mac keyboard, press ⌥⇧/. If that does not work on your layout, open ⌃⌘Space and search for U+00BF.
